trap.label: ordem + to
trap.wrong: The teacher told me don't talk.
trap.right: The teacher told me not to talk.
trap.why: Em português "mandou não falar"; em inglês use told + pessoa + not to + verbo.

mcq.q: Qual é a pergunta indireta correta?
opts: He asked where did I live.
He asked where I do live.
She asked that I was ready.
She asked if I was ready.
He told me to close the door.
He told me close the door.
He said me to close the door.

fix.wrong: She asked me where did I buy it.
fix.right: She asked me where I had bought it.
fix.why: Sem auxiliar do na pergunta indireta.

fix.wrong: He asked if was I tired.
fix.right: He asked if I was tired.
They told me not to worry.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “‘What is your job?’ he asked her.”
rewrite.answer: He asked her what her job was.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “‘Did you call?’ she asked me.”
rewrite.answer: She asked me if I had called.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva em discurso indireto: “‘Where do you live?’ he asked me.”
rewrite.answer: He asked me where I lived.
